title: Implement replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks
body:
Implement replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks change.
Specifications have already been written. Need to review them and update if necessary. Implement the change after that.

decisions.body:
Option 2, with these details.

1. Task 6.1: the three bench files exist, so only add the "bench" script to
   packages/client/package.json. First reword 6.1 in tasks.md so it says
   "add the `bench` script to `packages/client/package.json` (a script, no new
   dependency)". The stage check accepts package.json edits only when tasks.md
   says so. Then run its verification and tick it.

2. Turn 6.5, 6.6, 7.1 and 8.3 into plain bullets (no checkbox) under a new final
   section "## Human follow-up" in tasks.md. Keep their text, and put the
   requirement ids first:
   - H1 (FR7): 6.5 + 6.6, the ciBenchmarkJob test and the `benchmark` CI job.
     Why manual: `.github/` is outside the implement stage.
   - H2 (FR8): 7.1, the `.claude/rules` edits, ADR 0008 and the CLAUDE.md line.
     Why manual: `.claude/`, `docs/adr/` and CLAUDE.md are outside the
     implement stage.
   - H3 (M1, M5): check the PR's CI and the benchmark summary.
     Why manual: the sandbox has no GitHub access. The deliver stage opens
     the PR.
   The operator applies H1 and H2 in a follow-up PR after this one merges.

3. Task 8.1: drop FR7 from the id list (it lands with H1), and search only
   `src scripts`. If any other id is missing there, add the traceability
   comment in src, then tick 8.1.

Do not touch any other file outside packages/. Then rerun the full CI list
once, one command at a time.
decisions.author: tracker

lastEscalation.question: Five open tasks in replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks/tasks.md cannot be done under the implement-stage constraints, and the 'no open tasks' check cannot pass without breaking them. 6.1 needs a `bench` script in packages/client/package.json (the stage check rejects package.json edits unless tasks.md mentions 'pnpm add' or 'dependenc', and tasks.md is not editable). 6.5/6.6 need .github/workflows/ci.yml and a new benchmark job; 7.1 needs edits to .claude/rules/*, docs/adr/0008-*.md and CLAUDE.md; all of these are forbidden paths. 8.1 depends on those, and 8.3 asks the user to push and confirm on the PR. Bench files, budgets script and tests (6.2-6.4) are already done. How should I proceed?
options: Relax the stage checks/forbidden paths for this change so the implement round may edit package.json, .github, .claude, docs/adr and CLAUDE.md, then resume
Move tasks 6.5, 6.6, 7.1, 8.1 and 8.3 out of the implement stage (e.g. to a follow-up change or human step) and let me only add the bench script in package.json
